title: Martian Autonomy Research
purpose: Prove autonomous off-world industry and expose the limits of conventional programmable control.
optimization_opportunities: Mature programmable factories finish quickly; manual imports and intervention create the intended large pacing spread.
infrastructure_reuse: The Martian base, robotic cell, ComputerCraft programs, and existing interplanetary logistics become the AI proving ground.

milestones.title: Martian Science Program
final_validation: Complete the atmospheric, subsurface, radiation-computation, water-recovery, semiconductor, and robotics studies available on Mars.

milestones.title: Autonomous Resource Response
final_validation: Detect missing materials and automatically replenish or reschedule production.

milestones.title: Autonomous Power Response
final_validation: Detect power interruption, shed load safely, and restore production automatically.

milestones.title: Unattended Martian Production
final_validation: Complete local production without direct crafting while habitat and telemetry remain stable.

milestones.title: Martian Autonomy Archive
final_validation: Complete the Martian autonomy program and assemble its results into a Martian Autonomy Archive.
